# Mytour.vn

> Vietnam's leading travel platform offering hotel bookings, homestays, custom tours, and B2B business travel management solutions with exclusive deals across Asia.

Mytour.vn is operated by VNTravel Group and serves both leisure travelers and corporate clients. The platform specializes in last-minute deals, budget-luxury accommodations, and integrated expense tracking for business travel management.

## Key Topics

- Hotel booking
- Homestay & villa rentals
- Vietnam travel
- Last-minute deals
- Business travel management
- Expense tracking
- Budget-luxury accommodations
- Corporate solutions
- Custom tour packages
- Flash sales
- Asia destinations
- Gift cards & vouchers
- Approval workflows
- Cost control
- Booking system

## Hotel & Accommodation Booking

- [Hotel Booking - Budget to Luxury Options](https://mytour.vn/khach-san): Book from 100K+ hotel properties across Asia with best prices and same-day booking discounts
- [Mytour Mall - Premium Hotel Brands](https://mytour.vn/mall/thuong-hieu-khach-san-hang-dau): Exclusive deals on top hotel brands with special member pricing
- [Homestay & Villa Rentals](https://mytour.vn/homestay): Book vacation rentals, beachfront villas, and homestays in Vietnam with best rates
- [Hotels in Hung Yen & Vietnam Regions](https://mytour.vn/khach-san/khach-san-gia-tot/tp8/khach-san-tai-hung-yen.html): Regional hotel booking with budget-friendly options across Vietnam destinations

## Business Travel Solutions

- [Mytour for Business - Corporate Travel Management](https://business.mytour.vn): B2B SaaS platform for managing corporate travel with expense tracking, approval workflows, and cost control

## Tours & Events

- [Mytour Event - Custom Tours & Event Organization](https://event.mytour.vn/tour): Design custom tour packages and organize complete travel events tailored to client needs

## Travel Rewards & Gifting

- [Mytour Gift Card - Digital Travel Vouchers](https://giftcard.mytour.vn): Purchase digital gift cards for hotels, flights, and employee travel benefits
